user.title: Aquagem iSaver
user.description: Connect locally to the iSaver through an RS485/TCP gateway. For a WaveShare gateway, use TCP Server, port 502, 1200 baud, 8N1, Flow control None, Protocol None and Multi-host disabled. Do not use Modbus TCP to RTU mode.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Aquagem iSaver
reconfigure.description: Change the device name or RS485/TCP gateway connection. The connection is tested before saving. The gateway must remain in transparent mode: TCP Server, 1200 baud, 8N1 and Protocol None.

error.cannot_connect: Could not open a TCP connection to the gateway.
error.endpoint_in_use: This IP address and TCP port are already used by another Aquagem iSaver entry.

init.title: iSaver options
init.description: Set the polling interval, operating range and Home Assistant speed profiles. Speeds are limited to 1200–2900 rpm in 100 rpm steps.

error.invalid_speed_step: Speeds must be between 1200 and 2900 rpm in 100 rpm steps.
error.invalid_speed_range: Maximum speed must be greater than minimum speed.
error.profile_out_of_range: All profile speeds must be inside the configured minimum and maximum range.
